t: Security Regression Tester - public implementations survey
title: Security Regression Tester - public implementations survey
definition: Rechecks known security requirements after changes.
description:
Security Regression Tester is one of the fundamental capabilities an AI needs to build things on demand: Rechecks known security requirements after changes. In the real world this capability is delivered by a rich ecosystem of tools, libraries and platforms. This database is the public edition - a fact-checked survey of the real implementations, the real techniques they share, the standards they follow, and laddered drills that teach the capability hands-on.

No single tool owns Security Regression Tester. Competing implementations emphasize different trade-offs: speed against flexibility, simplicity against power, integration against independence. The implementation spotlights in this database document the notable real ones - what each does, where it excels, and how it serves Security Regression Tester. Together they map the territory as it actually exists.

Every record carries a runnable demonstration program, because tools are understood by use. Run the demos with node, compare the implementations, practice the drills, and the Security Regression Tester capability becomes something you can reach for - with full knowledge of which real tool fits which job.

In a Security Regression Tester build it shows up when throughput matters more than novelty. The design favors boring reliability over cleverness: well-trodden paths, clear errors, and behavior you can reason about without reading the source. Knowing the surrounding technology is part of knowing the capability - the best Security Regression Tester practitioners can say exactly where their tool ends and its neighbors begin.

For builders, OWASP Top 10 is a strong default choice as supporting technology. The demo program exercises a core idea from its domain - run it with node and watch each step.

Drill (FOUNDATION): name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Security Regression Tester from a one-paragraph brief
